# Affected crate strict checks

This independent workflow checks one immutable source and one fixed crate profile per request. It leaves every byte of the existing Fork CI workflow, including the original nine-crate strict job and every test, unchanged. The ACP task branch selects `acp`; the separate software-adapter task branch selects `gpui`. Bash checks exact branch spelling. An unmatched branch or skipped strict job supplies no compiler pass.

ACP selects source `bc9e48e0372407be6f8620c7d2fe8ed29beef7a6`, tree `f195ba68f2311afda6d9e2e618c746d447c182b3`. Its command is `./script/clippy --locked -p agent_servers -p acp_thread -p project -p gpui -p fs`. The four additional packages are direct workspace dependencies of agent_servers; Cargo also checks their transitive dependencies. The script adds `--release --all-targets --all-features -- --deny warnings` and its SHA-256 is frozen.

This descendant request selects GPUI source `1e258459b27b68a9c5fea47eb2530afbb7a7724a`, tree `12daa87ab45eeccd3f758946427011d11d02bac2`, on `android-studio-task/1-software-adapter-isolated-strict-ci`. Its fixed command is `./script/clippy --locked -p android_tools -p android_ui -p command_palette -p fs -p gpui -p project -p title_bar -p workspace -p zed`. It preserves the complete affected workflow and existing Fork CI byte-for-byte from reviewed ACP control `1606843b3525cf0e7873b3621beb0ab2d247cae5`; only the request profile, two source pins and this documentation change. The corrected source has five current static reviews and was normally published by Root. Actual strict execution and full source acceptance remain separate pending gates. The earlier `f279ec17c50d81e163769069d54fef7d0114edc2` failing new test and every prior diagnostic remain recorded; no pass is inferred from that revision or the former null-pin template.

The control checkout, loaded workflow commit, and strict source commit/tree are recorded separately. Both object IDs, tracked cleanliness, the frozen script, and Cargo.lock are checked before compilation. Bootstrap, repository toolchain, Node 24, WASI, C++ WebRTC, and runner concurrency follow the existing isolated job. No build cache is restored. The worker has a 180-minute budget; its command has a 165-minute deadline and its log capture has a 64-MiB cap. Deadline or capture failure fails the run and available raw logs, identities, command, and exit status are uploaded. A bounded capture failure cannot supply an overall pass.

Acceptance requires five independent infrastructure reviews, exact source/profile/command identity, actual zero-exit strict execution and zero-exit complete log capture, unchanged source afterward, and successful evidence retention. Clippy compiles test targets but executes no tests. Root must separately verify the source's actual full test suite, original assertions, full app build and native acceptance before completing a feature. CI244's inherited pinned42 jobs use earlier source `f5` and cannot establish bc9 source acceptance; actual full-workspace CI244 evidence must be attributed to its own checkout. The original nine-crate CI245 checks bf7, independently of either profile. The failed GPUI test, CI240 E0282 failure, and all earlier diagnostics remain recorded. No test, native, performance, reference-parity, or merge credit follows from prepared workflow definitions.

CI YAML, Bash, jq, timeout and existing Python bootstrap commands are infrastructure. They introduce no non-Rust IDE implementation.
